applyOnDiscountedItems.title: Apply role discount on already discounted items
applyOnDiscountedItems.description: When turned off, role discounts apply only to full-price products, not items already on promotional sale.

stackWithCoupons.title: Stack role prices with coupons
stackWithCoupons.description: Allow customers with role pricing to also redeem promotional discount coupons at checkout.

showOriginalPrice.title: Show original price comparison
showOriginalPrice.description: Display strikethrough retail price alongside wholesale role price to signed-in wholesale members.

minimumWholesaleOrder.title: Minimum wholesale order amount
minimumWholesaleOrder.description: Minimum order subtotal (in minor currency units) required before wholesale role prices take effect. 0 = no minimum.

wholesaleBadgeLabel.title: Role discount badge label
wholesaleBadgeLabel.description: Text shown on product cards, cart line items, and invoice summaries indicating wholesale role pricing.

enableVolumeTiers.title: Enable volume quantity tiers
enableVolumeTiers.description: Allow role-based volume tier discounts when buying in bulk quantities.
